app.open: Welcome, {addr}. I watch quietly, like still water.
The network flows. I simply notice.
all.good: All flows freely. Nothing to push, nothing to pull.
pc.busy: The PC strains at {v}. Ease its load and it will flow again.
Too much held at once. Let something go.
wifi.drops: The Wi-Fi slipped away {v} times. Move closer, like water finding its level.
net.none: No network. The path is broken; begin where it breaks - the cable or the Wi-Fi.
inet.slow: Your home is clear. The slowness lives further down the stream.
search.empty: Ask simply, and the answer comes simply.
freeze: A breath ({v}). The window will follow.
speedrunner: The last task is not finished. Wait, and it will be.
back.again: You return. Here is what changed while you were away.
dns.slow: Names come slowly ({v}). A small blockage in the stream.
speed.bloat: Fast, but the delay rises {v} when the river is full.
game.lag: The lag starts at your Wi-Fi, close to home.
vpn.slow: The VPN adds {v}. The longer road.
portal: This Wi-Fi asks for a sign-in first. A small gate on the path.
gw.down: Your router is silent. Start at the source.
isp.down: Your router answers; the world beyond does not. The provider holds the blockage.
mtu.small: Large packets are lost at {v}. Smaller ones pass easily.
cert.expired: The certificate ended on {v}. All things return to their root.
mtr.clean: The path is clear end to end.
late.night: It is late. Rest, as the river rests at night.
update.suspect: Things changed after the update on {v}. Look there.
call.on: A call. I watch its flow.
trade.ok: Your line to the broker is calm and steady.
trade.slow: The broker is slow. Wait - the still mind acts at the right moment.
quiz.wrong: Not this way. Flow and try again.
game.streak: {v} in a row - like water finding its path.
game.timeup: Time has passed, as it does.
market.open: The markets open, like a river after the dam.
storm.near: The storm comes; bend like the reed.
